name: marketer-companion-dashboard
description: Live marketing dashboard and reporting for GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, Merchant Center, Google Business Profile and CallRail.

interface.longDescription: Open a live marketing dashboard in ChatGPT for one business across GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, Merchant Center, Google Business Profile and CallRail. Compare periods, filter each source (channels, sources, mediums, key events, campaigns, queries, devices and more), break results down by any dimension, and ask ChatGPT to analyse the view you are looking at. Connect with your own Google account; CallRail is optional. Reporting is read-only.
defaultPrompt: Compare my GA4 sessions and key events with the previous 28 days.
Which Google Ads campaigns spent the most last month, and what did they convert?
